title: PAR-139.4 same-version SPATIAL_FILTER graph serialization
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Emit complete typed SPATIAL_FILTER records transactionally with a remapped/reserved self handle and a validated 32-bit owner
Require a same-source-version DXF target and stage the validated INSERT-to-filter dictionaries, filter-owned dictionaries, XRECORDs, and filters for OBJECTS output
Fail closed on unrecognized raw SPATIAL_FILTER group codes and unsupported sibling entries in the INSERT clipping dictionaries
Exercise same-adapter corrected retry, destination preservation, handle remapping, opaque XRECORD retention, and ASCII/Binary reimport
localEvidence: Generated ASCII and Binary controls use two INSERT instances of one block with separate ACAD_FILTER/SPATIAL owner chains and distinct paths/matrices
Generated fields cover front-only and back-only clipping distances; a filter-owned ACAD_XREC_ROUNDTRIP DICTIONARY/XRECORD is emitted and reimported
The source handle 0x10 collides with a fixed output handle and is remapped; dictionary/filter/XRECORD owner links survive readback
Target-version mismatch, dangling filter target, and cross-owned filter are refused before replacing the sentinel destination; the corrected graph then succeeds on the same adapter
The codec-level SPATIAL_FILTER writer uses a record transaction and checks each output call

assessment.planImpact: Implements same-version typed field and owner-graph output for the admitted SPATIAL_FILTER route. Unrecognized raw tags and sibling dictionary objects are refused; clipping visibility, inverted semantics, DWG-origin export qualification, and consumer support remain unproven.

limitations: Unrecognized raw SPATIAL_FILTER tags are refused rather than raw-replayed
Sibling objects on the INSERT ACAD_FILTER or SPATIAL dictionary routes are refused until complete closure/output support exists
The test verifies fields, owner graph, and reimport, not visible clipping or inversion semantics
No DWG-origin end-to-end SPATIAL_FILTER export or native consumer was qualified
